integrity: The statement is supported by a written all-parameter proof; finite program verification is corroborative rather than exhaustive for arbitrary parameters. Classical automorphism decomposition and binary q=2,t=2 count are acknowledged prior work.
scientific_limitations: Only the square radical of three-layer incidence algebras with layer sizes (2,s,t), s,t>=1; does not classify the whole radical.
Independent priority and proof audit not performed; the 2011 full text could not be inspected.
title: Automorphism orbits in the square radical of three-level incidence algebras
